text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Голд Сити was so cool!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: She was so strong! What a runner!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Trainer... did you hear the cheers? They
called me
strong...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
This means... all they saw was my
running... right?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Haha. You're so worked up. I was too,
but I've
calmed down now.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I can finally start running as the real me
now, as
just "Голд Сити."
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: You know... it's weird.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
There's a reflective tone in her voice, as
if she's
savoring the moment for all it's
worth. Starting
tomorrow, a whole new
chapter in her life will
begin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Or at least, that's what we both
thought...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow, City is going viral! She's all over
Umatter
and Umastagram.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Plus there are way more comments about
her
speed than her looks. Aw, I'm so
happy for her.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Hm? Wonder what this link is...
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what the heck?!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you scared me. Why are you
screaming?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Ah... City!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
What was that? It looked like it had my
name on
the screen...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Hey! D-don't look, pervert!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
What are you on about? Now I'm
curious. Let me
see.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: N-no! Go away!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Stop running!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Tch! Stop chasing! Ugh, how am I meant
to shake
a speed demon like you?! Go
easy on me!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Then just show me what you were
looking at, for
heck's sake!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I already told you, no! You'll have to
beat it out
of—eek!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Whoosh!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ah, my phooone! The screen's gonna
crack again!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Whew, close one.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Omigod, City! Thank you sooo much!
You're a
lifesaver!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Now, your passcode should be... this,
right?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Wha?! Wait—
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Uh, why were you looking at some
anonymous
forum?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Huh? What... is this?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
"I just want to see her race more and get
more
exposure. With that speed and
those looks, she's
going to be an actual
legend."
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna find these guys and beat the
crap out
of them! And if I can't do that,
I'll get hold of this
site's admin and—
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Calm down. No one here's dissing me,
they're just
talking.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But this is exactly the sort of thing
you've been
working so hard to get away
from!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Just look at these comments! They don't
care
about your feelings at all!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Literally, this makes me want to... to...
ARGHHH!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Why are you crying, silly?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I could care less. If anything...
this just
drives the truth home.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Running... won't change anything.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It had been less than two days since the
race
when Тосэн Джордан barged into my
office crying.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Jordan told you, huh? Then you should
already
know.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
No matter how good I get, I'll always just
be a
pretty doll to them.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Are you trying to say it isn't true?
People won't
ever stop talking about my
looks.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
In fact, the more I run, the more people
who only
care about that seem to
appear.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And I can't do a thing about it. I mean,
the Triple
Crown's already over.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
What better platform to show off my
running is
there?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
So what did I do wrong? I gave it
everything I
had.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Why won't anyone just watch me for my
ability?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Her fighting spirit is gone without a
trace. She
looks like an empty shell of
the runner I know.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What are you apologizing for?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Beauty leaves a lasting impression on
people. It
will take time before she can
change her
reputation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All she can do right now is keep running
without
giving up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
